bom.part: Solar panel, 6 V nominal, approximately 5 W
bom.description: Panel supplies controller and valve; no battery included.
Runs scheduled watering and weather/soil-based adjustments; weather data requires an external source or user configuration because wireless is not specified.

bom.part: Capacitive soil-moisture probe module, analog output
bom.description: Probe assembly with analog output for soil moisture measurement.
Regulates solar-panel supply for the controller and sensor.
Low-side valve-driver switch; verify voltage/current rating against selected valve coil.
Across solenoid coil for inductive transient suppression.

bom.part: Resistors, capacitors, connectors, and manual override switch
bom.description: Grouped passive and interconnect set, including MCU timing/bypass components, sensor connector, and momentary manual-watering input.
Moulded ASA, UV-stable; mates with top shell; approximately 150 × 60 × 190 mm.
Normally closed valve assembly compatible with the intended pipe and solar supply; confirm coil voltage/current during design verification.
Corrosion-resistant screws sized to secure the two housing shells.
Seals for probe, panel, and valve wiring penetrations.
Packaging set for one finished controller kit.
Stores solar energy to power the controller when sunlight is unavailable.
